children: growth plans have progressed well, and the company intends to make final investment decisions for the expansion of its CP2 and Plaquemines projects in next year's H1, and some equipment orders have already been placed, CEO Michael Sabel told
is advancing the two expansion projects to push its liquefied natural gas production capacity past 100M metric tons/year before the end of 2030.
The expansion at CP2 is expected to provide an additional 10M tons/year of LNG, and the Plaquemines expansion should increase production by 7M-8M tons/year.
LNG suppliers and analysts are split between those that forecast an impending supply glut once energy markets stabilize and those that expect demand will continue to rise, but Sabel told
that the company does not believe there is a supply glut.
expects a small LNG shortage heading into the early 2030s with large supply projects likely to run behind schedule, Sabel said.

The outlook is also clouded by questions over when lost volumes from Qatar will return to the market, as damage to the country's facilities from the Middle East conflict has cut the country’s export capacity by ~17%.

title: Venture Global CEO sees final investment decisions on two key projects in next year's H1
